items.front: Founder of the Qutb Shahi dynasty (1518) and former overlord?
items.back: Sultan Quli Qutb-ul-Mulk (Quli Qutb Mulk), a Bahmani governor of Telangana; one of five Deccan sultanates.

items.front: The Qutb Shahis broke away from which parent sultanate?
items.back: The Bahmani Sultanate; Golconda largely coincided with the old Kakatiya (Warangal) state.

items.front: Duration of the Qutb Shahi dynasty; sect and descent?
items.back: 1518–1687 CE; Shia Islam, of Turkoman (Qara Qoyunlu) descent, with a Persianate court.

items.front: Ruler titled 'Malkibharam', patron of Telugu, who built Hussain Sagar?
items.back: Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah (r.1550–80); the tank Hussain Sagar/Ibrahim Cheruvu dates to his reign.

items.front: Which sultan founded Hyderabad (1591) and built the Charminar?
items.back: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah (r.1580–1611), the 5th sultan.
Indo-Islamic/Indo-Saracenic; granite and lime mortar with four minarets.

items.front: Literary distinction of Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah?
items.back: His Kulliyat is the earliest Urdu (Deccani) diwan; he also wrote Telugu and Persian verse.

items.front: Golconda Fort's economic fame; the diamond mine linked to the Koh-i-Noor?
items.back: A great diamond-trading centre; the Kollur mine yielded the Koh-i-Noor and Hope diamonds.

items.front: Last Qutb Shahi ruler, and who annexed Golconda in 1687?
items.back: Abul Hasan Tana Shah; annexed by Aurangzeb (Mughals) after a long siege and betrayal.

items.front: Brahmin ministers of Abul Hasan Tana Shah; the devotee-official of Bhadrachalam?
Great mosque begun by Muhammad Quli and completed under Aurangzeb (1694)?

items.back: Muhammad Quli's consort Bhagmati (Hyder Mahal); the city is linked to 'Bhagyanagar'.

items.front: Necropolis of the Qutb Shahi kings?
items.back: The Qutb Shahi Tombs at Ibrahim Bagh (on Hyderabad's UNESCO tentative list with Golconda & Charminar).

items.front: Which line succeeded the Mughals in the Deccan at Hyderabad (1724)?
items.back: The Asaf Jahi Nizams — Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah I founded Hyderabad State.
